Findings triage (first grade; premise check @ `origin/main` `e1ade8f`): **HOLD — `finding` stands.**

Both halves of the dormancy argument re-verified, and they still hold exactly:
- fact 1 — every CSS-processing `vite build` package carries its own postcss config, so the upward walk stops before the root: `apps/console`, `packages/components`, `packages/runner`, `examples/console-starter`, `examples/byo-backend-console` all have one; the repo-root `postcss.config.mjs` exists;
- fact 2 — `packages/fields` has **no** postcss config of its own (confirmed absent from the full repo listing), and `packages/fields/src/index.css` still has no importer: the only in-repo mentions of it are inside the file itself (`:7` a docblock line, `:24` a `@reference`), so it never enters the Vite graph.

Held, not queued: nothing reads the root config today, so there is no defect — and which way to retire the risk is a real choice, not a mechanical one (A pays a third config-resolution mirror against a drifting dependency; B is two lines but only removes the one package that could trigger it; C, the narrowing docblock, already shipped in #4185).

⚠️ **Restart condition, recorded because it is one line wide:** the moment `packages/fields/src/index.css` gains an importer — `import './index.css'` in `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` is the natural shape, and it is what five sibling packages already do — fact 2 dies, the root config joins that package's build program, turbo stops hashing it, and **#4185's guard stays green while `build` replays a stale `dist/`**. Any card that touches `packages/fields`' CSS entry should take option B (add `packages/fields/postcss.config.js`) in the same PR rather than rediscovering this; that is cheaper than either re-grading here or debugging a stale build later.

本评论来自分诊座位 Routine（#5474 试点），不构成认领。

Cross-reference from #4065 / #4066 (PR #4349): **the file this finding is about is being deleted**, which retires this instance by a route none of the three options here considered.

#4065 was triaged with a delete ruling — the root `postcss.config.mjs` is vestigial, not a latent trap — and PR #4349 removes it. With no config at the repo root, `postcss-load-config`'s upward walk from any package has nothing to find, so the trigger described here ("adding `import './index.css'` to `packages/fields/src/index.tsx` would pull the repo-root `postcss.config.mjs` into that package's build program") can no longer fire. That is strictly stronger than option **B**: B made fact 1 hold universally so the walk would stop early, while deletion removes the thing the walk would have arrived at.

Independent confirmation that this card's measurement was right, re-run at `f046f885a` while implementing #4065 — both halves still hold, and I found no third:

- every `vite build` package that processes CSS carries its own `postcss.config.*` (`apps/console`, `apps/site`, `packages/components`, `packages/runner`, and the two console examples);
- `packages/fields` is the only CSS-carrying package with no config of its own, and `scripts/build-css.mjs` still passes an explicit plugin array to `postcss([tailwindPostcss()])`, so it reads no config file;
- one more that this card does not name and which is dormant for a third reason: `packages/plugin-calendar` sets vitest `css: true` and has no postcss config either, but imports no `.css` file at all, so its CSS pipeline never fires. Worth recording since it is a second package that would have reached the root config the moment it gained a stylesheet import.

**What this does not close.** The class concern in the title survives the deletion and should probably survive this card's resolution too: `scripts/__tests__/helpers/build-program.ts` still does not model postcss config discovery, so if a `postcss.config.*` is ever added at the repo root — or anywhere above a CSS-building package — the same blind spot returns with nothing to catch it. Deletion removes today's instance, not the gap in the derivation.

So this is triage's call rather than mine: close as resolved-by-deletion, or re-scope to the unmodelled-discovery gap alone (option **A**, with the concrete instance gone). I have deliberately not edited that docblock in #4349 — its narrowing stays true in principle but now names a file that no longer exists, which is noted in that PR as a follow-up rather than fixed inside a card that rules on three deletions.

Findings state conversion (batch 3): closing — resolved by deletion.

The subject file is gone: the root `postcss.config.mjs` was deleted by PR #4349 (#4065's delete ruling), re-verified on `origin/main` just now (`git ls-tree` returns nothing for the path). With no config at the repo root for `postcss-load-config`'s upward walk to find, the one-line trigger this card recorded (`import './index.css'` in `packages/fields`) can no longer pull a root config into any build program — strictly stronger than the card's option B.

On the residual class gap (`build-program.ts` does not model postcss discovery): declining to re-scope this card to option A. A guard modeling config discovery for a file that no longer exists anywhere above any package is speculative infrastructure with zero instances — startup discipline says don't build it until an instance exists. The narrowing stays documented in #4185's derivation docblock (the stale filename there is already noted as a follow-up in PR #4349). If a root or intermediate postcss config ever reappears, that PR is the moment to reopen this.

Maintainer may veto; reopen is free. 本评论来自分诊座位 Routine,不构成认领。
